summary: gcli2api Management schema 1.0 read provider is ready for the manager compatibility matrix. Independent token authentication, truthful capabilities, summary, paginated credential metadata, stats, UTC/null handling, strict field whitelisting, OpenAPI baseline, Legacy regressions, and a non-published amd64/arm64 candidate build have passed.
compatibility: The default-disabled router is independent from API and panel passwords. SQLite and PostgreSQL declare all five read capabilities; MySQL and MongoDB declare only node.summary and credential.list because unsupported statistics remain undeclared. Legacy routes remain registered. No write or external-side-effect capability is present.
tests: Windows Python 3.12: 74 tests passed, including real temporary SQLite, both modes, authentication, pagination, nullable UTC metadata, capability truthfulness, Legacy route registration, and sensitive-field exclusion
PR #8 gcli2api-ci passed on Python 3.13; OpenAPI baseline and sensitive-literal gates passed
PR #8 Docker run 31519184271 built linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 tags pr-8 and sha-68f6de1 with registry login skipped and push=false
Compile and Git whitespace checks passed; no image was published and no environment was deployed
next_actions: On the latest gcli2api-manager main, consume the merged dev7 provider contract and run the final Modern schema 1.0 candidate compatibility matrix without production nodes or credentials.
Re-run Legacy Current, Legacy Minimal, and Unknown fixtures beside the Modern complete, partial, additive, malformed, future-minor, future-major, missing-capability, and 401 cases.
Verify that the manager calls only declared capabilities, never falls back after 401/403, preserves nullable unknowns, and excludes sensitive fields from database, logs, API, and browser output.
Close MGMT-004 only after the manager matrix PR is green and merged; do not publish or deploy the build-only candidate image.
